import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 4:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 0), (0, 1)):
                ar, ac = r - dr, c - dc
                while 0 <= ar < h and 0 <= ac < w and grid[ar][ac] == 4:
                    ar -= dr
                    ac -= dc
                br, bc = r + dr, c + dc
                while 0 <= br < h and 0 <= bc < w and grid[br][bc] == 4:
                    br += dr
                    bc += dc
                if (0 <= ar < h and 0 <= ac < w and 0 <= br < h and 0 <= bc < w
                    and grid[ar][ac] == 9 and grid[br][bc] == 9):
                    out[r][c] = 2
                    break
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(source)
